newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex debt totals $4.648 bln at end of Q3.
newsitem.headline: Cemex debt totals $4.648 bln at end of Q3.

text.p: Mexico's Cemex SA said on Friday its total debt at the end of the third quarter stood at $4.648 billion, or 52.7 percent of its equity.

"Total debt as of September 30, 1996, stood at 35.092 billion pesos ($4.648 billion)... Leverage (debt to equity ratio) at the close of the quarter was 52.7 percent," Cemex said in a breakdown of its third-quarter results.

The cement producer said 86.1 percent of its debt was denominated in dollars (about $4 billion), 8.4 percent in pesetas (about 50.155 billion pesetas) and 2.5 percent in Mexican pesos (1.053 billion pesos).
Average interest rates payable on debt during the third quarter were 8.5 percent in dollars, 7.9 percent in pesetas and 32 percent in Mexican pesos.
